title: Referral links in some Markdown text responses
summary:
A referral experiment touched Markdown replies, visit routing, and chat-response metadata.

About 1% of eligible Markdown text responses can have existing product or concept mentions turned into up to three referral links. Plain-text responses are left unchanged, and processing errors return the original content.

The new /referral route records the topic from a link, then sends visitors to the pollinations.ai homepage after three seconds.

OpenAI-format responses now receive a newly generated ID and creation timestamp rather than retaining provider values. The response helper also stops filling in missing choice indexes and adding its previous cache header.
